notes.note: Just 2 disposals and 2 marks for Bamert this week and he did drop a few marks. His spot in the side could be in jeopardy this week.
Bamert kicked a goal from his 8 disposals with this his lowest score so far. He isn't going to be a big scorer but if you got him for the bench then he looks like he may hold his spot.
Bamert had a good second game with 15 disposals and 7 marks but he isn't one of the mid season draftees that you would want to bring in.

The mid season draftee was good on debut with a goal and 11 touches as he looked good to the eye but he didn't reflect that in his SuperCoach scoring unfortunately. There are other mid season guys to get in before him.
